subject: I would add
author: Flamechu
body: ALL music from Burnout 1, 2, and 3. After finding a POI soundtrack, I know there are a few missing in Paradise.

subject: Oooh.. My new number 1
author: Wei
body:
I am not sure why I did not think of that, but this would rock.  I, and about half of my gaming friends, have Paradise on PS3, while my other gamer friends have it on 360.  It would be great if we could play against each other.

Unfortunately, the devs have alread addressed this and said it was technically possible, but the manufacturers would not allow it.

subject: Checkpoints
author: Mad Wookiee11
body:
In addition to the PS3 - Xbox 360 connectivity, I would add a more in depth way to create checkpoints on the game, like on top of a Parking Garage, or on the dirt track.  It probably would be too complicated to find in mid - race, but it still would be interesting.

Utinam logica falsa tuam philosophiam totam suffodiant!
